about: Lisbon Fringe's events: the alternative, community and side events around Web Summit Lisbon, 11 to 13 November 2026 (and a few either side). Each event was re-read at its public source_url at read_at (UTC; Lisbon is on UTC in November). Each says whether Storm Charles moved it. Labels: fact (read on the organiser's page), evidence (read, but the page leaves the status open), hypothesis (not confirmed at source). 'unknown' means we do not know. Organisers are organisations; no private person is named and no contact details are given.
contract: api/v1/README.md (v1). Required: name, url, read_at, date, start, end, kind, organiser, place, join, status, storm_note, topics. Added by the researcher (v1 allows additions): id, label (fact | evidence | hypothesis), cost (as stated), storm_moved (true | false | null), check (what the page says about the storm, or why status is open), note.
independence: Lisbon Fringe is independent of Web Summit and is not run by its organisers. For anything official see the organisers' own pages. Not a warning service: for the storm see IPMA (https://www.ipma.pt), ANEPC (https://www.prociv.gov.pt) and https://storm-charles.promptugal.news.
